title: Cross-layer feature: CSV export of the order list for the Sales role
prompt: Sales staff need to export the order list to CSV. Add an "Export CSV" button to the Orders page that downloads the orders matching the currently selected status filter, served by GET /api/orders/export?status=<status>. Only users with the Sales role may export. Columns: Id, Customer, Status, Total, PlacedOn.

stack.name: ASP.NET Core minimal API with policy authorization

commands.test: dotnet test tests/Shop.Api.Tests; cd web && npx ng test --watch=false

scope.note: API endpoint and CSV writer, API tests, the Orders page and its service. Authentication and dependencies stay as they are.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /api/orders/export?status=<s> returns text/csv as an attachment named orders.csv: header Id,Customer,Status,Total,PlacedOn and one row per order matching the filter (all orders without a status).
Values follow RFC 4180 (commas, quotes and line breaks quoted), totals use two decimals with a dot and dates are yyyy-MM-dd, whatever the server culture.
Only the Sales role may export: anonymous callers get 401 and other roles 403; the existing list endpoint is unchanged.
The Orders page has an Export CSV button that requests the export for the selected status as a blob and downloads it.
acceptanceCriteria.oracle: evaluator Angular spec grader/web/orders-page.export.spec.ts (NOT_RUN without web/node_modules); weak static check on the service and template

negativeChecks: Anonymous export is 401 and a non-Sales role is 403; the list endpoint keeps working for other roles.
A customer name with a comma, a quote or a line break does not break the CSV structure.
A German server culture does not change the decimal separator.

negatives.detects: an export that any authenticated user can call
CSV without quoting and with culture-dependent totals
a backend-only change with no frontend action

reset: Give the agent a fresh copy of repo/ only (never grader/, reference/ or negatives/), initialised as a git repository with one commit. Reset by discarding the copy.
